title: These are the Trump investigations Democrats plan if they win in November
description: Democrats hope to retake control of the House, and to use that power to probe Trump’s business ventures, legal maneuvers and policies.

title: Neighbor turned on neighbor after Charlie Kirk's killing. Is the divide here to stay?
description: The assassination of far right activist Charlie Kirk opened the floodgates of neighbor-on-neighbor doxing. A year later, the damage to political discourse in the U.S. remains.

title: Woman deported to Afghanistan in first use of Alien Terrorist Removal Court
description: Nazira Haji Zada conceded being an “alien terrorist” in a case heard by a secretive court established three decades ago but which held its first hearing this year.

title: Ethics watchdogs await RFK Jr.'s financial report
description: Health Secretary RFK Jr.'s annual financial disclosure is late. When it posts, the public could learn how much he has earned from a vaccine-related lawsuit against Merck, which RFK now regulates.

title: For years, Bush was mocked for this 9/11 moment. Now he’s painted it.
description: President George W. Bush took up painting after leaving the White House in 2009 and has since made it a conspicuous part of his post-presidency.

title: Ohio Senate campaign staffer used Nazi soldiers as profile photo
description: A top staffer for Sen. Jon Husted's reelection campaign recently made a playlist of songs in honor of White colonists in Rhodesia and wore a Nazi uniform.

title: Ballot scramble hints at chaos under Trump proposal, Fla. election official says
description: A county elections supervisor in the state said the Postal Service initially rejected the ballots envelope he was planning to use over a 0.014-inch discrepancy.

title: At the Pentagon, Trump ties the legacy of 9/11 to his Iran war
description: President Donald Trump spoke at a solemn Pentagon ceremony marking the attacks of Sept. 11, 2001, and edged close to embracing policies he has long criticized.

title: Mayor of the 'Air Capital of the World' reacts to Trump's threats against Bombardier
description: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer talks with Wichita Mayor Lily Wu about President Trump's tariff war with Canada, Bombardier aircrafts, and the trade war's potential impact on her city.

title: Trump heads to Ireland to watch some golf at his club and conduct some diplomacy
description: President Trump heads to Ireland hoping for a little diplomacy as he watches a tournament at his golf club in Doonbeg.

title: Trump asks convention crowd to pledge to him they will vote, ‘cheat like hell’
description: At the midterm event, the president had audience members raise their hands and repeat after him.

title: GOP state senator who defied Trump named winner, four months after close election
description: The Indiana state Senate election was held in May but was close, prompting a challenge.

title: Al Franken, other Jewish Americans endorse El-Sayed in Michigan Senate race
description: Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic nominee in the Michigan Senate race, has faced a backlash from some Jewish Democrats for his intense criticism of Israel.

title: These congressmen went to war after 9/11. It changed them in different ways.
description: Two veterans from different political parties took disparate lessons from the post-9/11 wars.

title: The post-9/11 wars changed politics. Not everyone who served agrees how.
description: Interviews with two veterans in Congress highlight how the terrorist attacks that sparked wars in Iraq and Afghanistan changed the nation’s politics but did not leave its leaders with monolithic views.

title: 4 takeaways from the GOP midterm convention
description: Trump got his big show. Vance took the baton. “Common sense” was the refrain. No bad vibes allowed.

title: Republicans try at midterm convention to aid Paxton in his tight Senate race
description: Republicans hoped to boost enthusiasm for Ken Paxton during the two-day event in Dallas. The Texas attorney general is facing off against Democrat James Talarico in November for a U.S. Senate seat.

title: Remembering 9/11. And, Vance, Trump urge voters to back Republicans in the midterms
description: NPR reflects on the events of 9/11 and the toll it left on the U.S. 25 years later. And, President Trump and Vice President Vance's convention speeches urge voters to back the GOP in the midterms.

title: Empty seats, socialism and Trump dominate the Republican midterm convention
description: The two day Republican convention in Dallas showcased the party's biggest asset in trying to win competitive midterm races and its greatest obstacle: President Trump.

title: These Michigan swing voters are bracing for higher prices from trade war with Canada
description: President Trump's tariff standoff with Canada is rankling some key voters ahead of this year's midterm elections.

title: From DOGE to "space lasers," Alex Gibney peels back the many layers of Elon Musk
description: In the Oscar-winning filmmaker's latest documentary, director Alex Gibney investigates the rise of Elon Musk and says what's behind Musk's success are distressing truths.

title: Vance, Trump urge Americans to support Republicans on last night of convention
description: Vice President Vance delivered remarks at the final night of the Republican Midterm Convention, as President Trump relished his last convention as the Republican Party's dominant leader.

title: Republican strategist shares takeaways from Vance's speech at the GOP convention
description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Republican strategist Rina Shah about the main takeaways from Vice President Vance's speech at the Republican Midterm Convention.

title: GOP convention attendee calls for shooting Democrats during Cruz’s speech
description: Democrats condemned the calls for violence. The Republican senator did not address the outburst in the moment but later posted a clip in which it could be clearly heard.

title: Vance appears more like Trump’s heir apparent at GOP convention
description: The vice president characterized Democrats as the “party of hatred,” while urging Republicans to unify. His role could strengthen his potential presidential bid.

title: Prosecutor leading probe into Trump foes resigns, vows investigation will continue
description: Joseph diGenova — a Trump loyalist — told The Washington Post that he has submitted his resignation to the attorney general amid disagreements over the pace of the investigation into Trump's political foes.

title: See photos from the Republican midterm convention
description: The two-day event features elected Republican officials, musical performances and other speakers in support of the party’s midterm candidates.

title: RFK Jr. uses military aircraft as he campaigns for GOP in midterms
description: The White House and Department of Health and Human Services lawyers signed off on the plan to let the health secretary use military jets, according to people familiar with the plan.

title: Trump team expands midterm spending to $57 million so far
description: The operation’s long-awaited spree fortified competitive House races.

title: Trump said the top U.S. general was at the midterm convention. It’s not true.

title: Senior House leader to talk about Republicans targeting ‘communism’ in midterms
description: Conference chairwoman Lisa McClain will focus on Democratic policies, including those on immigration.

description: The countermessaging includes speaking to Texas voters about affordability issues and Democratic efforts to regain control of the House.

title: Supreme Court again blocks new Missouri congressional map favoring GOP
description: The ruling is the latest twist in an intense legal drama that has plunged the state into electoral confusion.

title: Rival pro-Israel group to spend millions to target AIPAC-backed candidates
description: The super PAC of J Street, a liberal pro-Israel group, is spending $3 million on ads against Republicans backed by AIPAC.

title: GOP secretaries of state ask Supreme Court to block Trump mail-in ballot rule
description: The proposed change would significantly increase the likelihood of midterm election issues, they warned.

title: In posts attacking ChatGPT, Katie Miller didn’t disclose her stake in its rival
description: Conservative podcaster Miller, a former top aide to Elon Musk, is the latest political influencer to comment on public issues without fully disclosing financial ties.

title: Sending armed ICE agents to polling places would be a federal crime, lawsuit says
description: Latino civil rights groups and Denver sued the Trump administration on Thursday, invoking a law Congress passed in the final months of the Civil War.

title: In Dallas, Trump says Mavericks’ Luka Doncic trade may be ‘worst of all time’
description: Speaking in Dallas, the home of Doncic’s former NBA team, the president joked that "we gotta redo that deal."

title: Remembering Roger Simon, a political journalist with toughness and wit
description: Dan Balz pays tribute to “a craftsman of the first order,” who wrote for Chicago newspapers before joining Politico as a columnist. He died Thursday at 78.

title: What happened the last times Trump pitched direct payments to Americans
description: The White House hasn’t elaborated on how a newly proposed $5,000 “dividend” would work.

title: New Mexico leaders ask Apple and Google not to use ‘New America’ on their maps
description: Members of the state’s congressional delegation said they don’t want a repeat of what happened with Lake America and the Gulf of America.

title: What to know about Trump’s proposed $5,000 payouts
description: The president has pledged direct payments to Americans several times since returning to office.

title: Trump announces rebate checks are on the way for people overcharged by ACA
description: President Donald Trump announced that $500 rebate checks would go to about 1 million Americans he said had been wrongly overcharged through the Affordable Care Act.

title: Obama fundraising with Democrats as GOP holds night 2 of convention
description: The former president plans to join House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries (D-New York) at an event in New York.

title: Seven simple tips to understand midterm election polls
description: Plus: Confidence in K-12 schools and 9/11 memories.

title: Democratic socialist wins primary for mayor of Providence, Rhode Island
description: David Morales, a state lawmaker and member of the Democratic Socialists of America, defeated incumbent Mayor Brett Smiley.
